custom_fields.label: Source Document Type
custom_fields.description: Operational document that caused this recovery, such as a Vehicle Incident. Set by the system; one source document raises at most one advance.

custom_fields.label: Source Document
custom_fields.description: The originating operational document this advance recovers.

custom_fields.label: Signed Recovery Evidence
custom_fields.description: Immutable snapshot of the signed evidence on the operational source when this advance was raised.

custom_fields.label: Agreed Installment
custom_fields.description: Immutable per-pay-period installment agreed on the operational source when this advance was raised.
